_comment: Gemma 4 12B (mlx-community/gemma-4-12B-it-4bit) — text decoder of Gemma4UnifiedForConditionalGeneration. Fields flattened from HF text_config to TOP-LEVEL (extract_bounds only captures top-level ints/scalars). Two attention classes: sliding (head_dim 256, 8 kv, window 1024, theta 1e4 full rotary) and global (global_head_dim 512, 1 kv, k_eq_v, proportional rope rot=0.25*512=128 denom=512, theta 1e6). Scale=1.0 BOTH classes via attention_multiplier. attn_q_dim/q_global_dim/kv_dim/k_global_dim are derived dims for weights.json. weight_leaf_renames folds the *_global DSL names back to the shared on-disk leaves.
